title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Sweet Potato and Sage
blurb: Tender pork fillet roasted with sweet potato, potatoes and leek, finished with fresh sage.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Peel the sweet potato and potatoes, then cut them into chunks of roughly the same size.
Trim the leek, slice it lengthways, rinse out any grit, then cut into thick rounds.
Put the sweet potato, potatoes and leek into a roasting tin with half the olive oil, half the salt and some pepper, and toss to coat. Roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with the remaining olive oil, salt and pepper.
Remove the tin from the oven, push the vegetables to the sides and place the pork in the centre. Scatter the sage leaves over everything.
Return to the oven and roast for 20 minutes until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the roasted vegetables.
